Season the fish with salt and grill 7 minutes a side.
Fry the onion and tomato in the oil, add the greens and a splash of water, cook 8 minutes.
Stir in the ground peanut if using, season, and serve with the nsima and fish.
dishes.mp: Greens keep 3 days. Nsima is best fresh.
light: Smaller nsima portion and more greens

dishes.n: Chicken tagine with olives and preserved lemon
dishes.d: Slow-cooked chicken with saffron, ginger, green olives and preserved lemon.
steps: Marinate the chicken in the spices, garlic, herbs and oil for an hour.
Lay the sliced onion in the base of a tagine or heavy pot and put the chicken on top.
Add a cup of water, cover and cook on low 45 minutes.
Add the olives and sliced preserved lemon and cook 15 minutes more uncovered to reduce.
Season and finish with fresh herbs.
ways: Heavy casserole in a 325°F oven for 75 minutes
dishes.mp: Keeps 4 days and improves overnight.

dishes.d: Yellow lentils simmered soft and finished with a sizzling spice tempering.
steps: Boil the dal with turmeric, salt and 4 cups of water 25 minutes until soft, or pressure cook 8 minutes.
Whisk it smooth and keep it loose with hot water.
Heat the ghee, crackle the cumin, then fry the garlic, chillies and onion until golden.
Add the tomatoes and garam masala and cook 5 minutes.
Pour the tempering over the dal, stir, and serve with rice and coriander.
ways: Stir the tempering in and simmer 5 minutes
dishes.mp: Keeps 4 days and thickens; loosen with water.
light: 1 tbsp ghee and more dal than rice
prot: Add paneer or a boiled egg

dishes.n: Jerk chicken with rice and peas
dishes.d: Chicken marinated in allspice, thyme and scotch bonnet, grilled, with coconut rice and beans.
steps: Blend the peppers, allspice, thyme, spring onion, soy and sugar into a marinade.
Coat the chicken and leave at least 4 hours, ideally overnight.
Grill over low coals or roast at 400°F (200°C) for 35–40 minutes, turning, until charred and cooked.
Cook the rice with the beans, coconut milk, thyme and a whole scotch bonnet.
Serve together, removing the whole pepper from the rice.
ways: Jerk fish or tofu with the same marinade
dishes.mp: Marinade keeps a week. Cooked chicken keeps 3 days.
light: Skinless chicken and plain rice instead of coconut

dishes.d: Smooth red lentil soup with mint and lemon, cheap and filling.
steps: Fry the onion, carrot and potato in the oil 6 minutes.
Add the lentils, cumin and stock and simmer 25 minutes until everything collapses.
Blend smooth, adding water to the thickness you like.
Warm the paprika and mint in a little oil and swirl it over the top.
Season and serve with plenty of lemon.
ways: Add bulgur for a heartier bowl
dishes.mp: Keeps 5 days and freezes 3 months.

dishes.d: Soft layered flatbread with red kidney beans stewed in tomato and coconut.
steps: Make a soft dough with flour, salt and water, rest 20 minutes.
Roll thin, brush with oil, coil into a spiral, then roll flat again for layers.
Cook on a dry hot pan 1–2 minutes a side, brushing lightly with oil.
Fry the onion, add tomatoes, cumin and chilli and cook 8 minutes.
Add the beans and coconut milk and simmer 12 minutes until thick.
ways: Serve the beans with rice instead
dishes.mp: Beans keep 4 days. Chapati keeps 2 days wrapped.
light: One chapati, 1 tbsp oil, light coconut milk

dishes.d: Steamed cassava couscous with a peppery folded omelette.
steps: Sprinkle the attiéké with water and steam 8 minutes until fluffy.
Chop the tomato, onion and chilli finely.
Beat the eggs with salt and the chopped vegetables.
Cook in the oil over medium heat, folding once, until just set.
Serve over the attiéké.
dishes.mp: Attiéké keeps 3 days; cook eggs fresh.
prot: Four eggs and a side of beans

dishes.d: Warm millet porridge finished with groundnut paste and sour milk.
steps: Whisk the millet flour into a cup of cold water until smooth.
Bring the rest of the water to a boil and pour the slurry in while stirring.
Simmer 15 minutes, stirring, until thick.
Loosen the groundnut paste with warm porridge and stir it back in.
Sweeten and serve with sour milk poured over.
dishes.mp: Keeps 2 days; thins when reheated.
prot: Extra groundnut paste and a boiled egg

dishes.d: Soft rice cooked down with ginger, lime and a little sugar.
steps: Rinse the rice and boil with the water and a pinch of salt.
Simmer 20–25 minutes, stirring, until the grains collapse.
Stir in the ginger and cook 2 more minutes.
Sweeten to taste and finish with lime juice.
Serve warm, thinned with water if you like it looser.
dishes.mp: Keeps 3 days; add water on reheating.
prot: With a boiled egg and peanuts

dishes.d: Dense sweet rice-flour bread with mashed banana, served with peanut butter.
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F (175°C) and grease a loaf tin.
Mix the mashed banana, eggs, sugar and oil.
Fold in the rice flour, baking powder and ginger.
Pour in and bake 40–45 minutes until a skewer comes out clean.
Cool, slice and spread with peanut butter.
ways: Without sugar, as a plain bread
dishes.mp: Keeps 4 days wrapped, freezes 2 months.
prot: Two slices and a boiled egg

dishes.d: Steamed millet couscous stirred through cool sour milk and a little sugar.
ing: 2 cups sour milk or plain yoghurt
steps: Sprinkle the millet with salted water and rest 10 minutes.
Steam 12 minutes until tender, breaking up lumps halfway.
Cool to warm, not hot.
Stir through the sour milk and sugar.
Serve cool.
dishes.mp: Keeps 2 days chilled.

dishes.d: Sweet millet cream with groundnut paste and baobab fruit.
steps: Steam the millet 15 minutes until soft.
Soak the baobab pulp in warm water and strain out the seeds.
Loosen the groundnut paste with the baobab liquid.
Fold everything through the millet with the sugar and orange blossom.
Chill and serve cool.
dishes.mp: Keeps 3 days chilled; stir before serving.

dishes.d: Smooth rice porridge with crisp black-eyed pea fritters on the side.
steps: Whisk the rice flour into cold water, then pour into boiling water while stirring.
Simmer 12 minutes until smooth and thick, then sweeten.
Blend the peas with onion and chilli into a stiff batter and whisk hard.
Fry spoonfuls 4 minutes until deep gold.
Serve the fritters beside the pap.
dishes.mp: Pap keeps 2 days; fry akara fresh.
light: Air-fry the akara, no sugar in the pap
prot: Extra akara and a boiled egg

dishes.d: Thick barley porridge with a well of spiced butter and berbere in the middle.
steps: Boil the salted water, then rain in the barley flour while stirring hard.
Keep beating 12–15 minutes until very thick and smooth.
Shape into a mound in a bowl and press a well into the middle.
Melt the butter with the berbere and pour it into the well.
Serve with yoghurt on the side.
ways: Oil instead of butter for fasting days
Half the berbere for less heat
dishes.mp: Best fresh; it stiffens as it cools.
prot: Extra yoghurt and a boiled egg

dishes.d: Tangy fermented millet and sorghum porridge, drunk warm from a mug.
steps: Mix the flour with 2 cups of cold water and leave overnight to sour.
Bring the remaining water to a boil.
Pour in the soured slurry while stirring.
Simmer 15 minutes until it thickens and loses the raw taste.
Sweeten, add a squeeze of lemon and serve warm.
dishes.mp: Slurry keeps 3 days; cook fresh.
prot: With peanuts and a boiled egg

dishes.d: Lightly sweet coconut-cardamom fried bread with spiced milk tea.
steps: Make a soft dough with flour, sugar, cardamom, yeast and coconut milk. Rest 1 hour.
Roll out and cut into triangles.
Fry 2 minutes a side until puffed and golden.
Simmer the milk with tea and crushed ginger 5 minutes.
Serve the mandazi hot with the chai.
dishes.mp: Dough keeps a day chilled; fry fresh.
prot: With a boiled egg and peanuts

dishes.d: Soft fried dough balls with a spoonful of stewed beans, the standard street breakfast.
steps: Mix flour, sugar, yeast, salt and warm water into a thick batter. Rest 1 hour until doubled.
Fry spoonfuls in hot oil 3 minutes until golden all round.
Fry the onion in the palm oil, add the beans and a splash of water.
Season and simmer 10 minutes until thick.
Serve the puff-puff with the beans.
ways: Beans on their own with bread
dishes.mp: Beans keep 4 days; fry the dough fresh.
prot: Extra beans and a boiled egg

dishes.d: Sweet fried plantain with soft eggs and a fresh tomato relish.
steps: Slice and fry the plantains 3 minutes a side until deep gold.
Chop the tomato, onion and chilli for a fresh relish and salt it.
Beat the eggs and cook softly in the same pan.
Plate the plantain with the eggs alongside.
Spoon the relish over.
dishes.mp: Best fresh.

dishes.d: Soft maize porridge with roasted groundnut flour stirred through.
steps: Mix the maize meal with a cup of cold water.
Pour into boiling water while stirring to stop lumps.
Simmer 15 minutes, stirring often.
Stir in the groundnut flour and cook 3 more minutes.
Sweeten lightly and serve.
dishes.mp: Keeps 2 days; loosen with water.
prot: Extra groundnut flour and an egg

dishes.d: Soft maize porridge with warm milk, butter and cinnamon sugar.
steps: Stir the maize meal into cold salted water.
Bring to a boil, stirring, then simmer 15 minutes covered.
Beat smooth and stir in the butter.
Spoon into bowls and pour the warm milk over.
Finish with cinnamon sugar.
dishes.mp: Keeps 2 days; add milk on reheating.

dishes.d: Leftover maize sadza sliced and fried with a soft egg and tomato relish.
steps: Slice the cold sadza into thick fingers.
Fry in 2 tbsp oil until crisp on both sides.
In another pan fry the onion, add chopped tomato and chilli, cook 8 minutes.
Crack the eggs into the relish and cover until just set.
Serve over the fried sadza.
dishes.mp: Uses up sadza; best eaten the same morning.

dishes.d: Pressed buttered bread dunked into strong coffee with hot milk.
steps: Split the bread lengthways and butter both cut sides.
Press in a hot pan under a weight 3 minutes until flat and crisp.
Cut into lengths.
Brew strong coffee and sweeten it while hot.
Top with hot milk and serve the toast alongside for dunking.
dishes.mp: Best fresh.

dishes.d: Soft sweet roll, pressed and dusted with sugar, filled with egg and ham.
steps: Split the rolls and butter the cut sides.
Press in a hot pan 2 minutes until golden.
Fry the eggs softly and warm the ham.
Fill each roll with egg and ham.
Dust the top with icing sugar and serve.
ways: Plain with just butter and sugar
dishes.mp: Best fresh.
light: No butter, one egg, skip the sugar

dishes.d: Soft coconut flatbread with a bright raw salt cod, tomato and pepper salad.
steps: Soak the salt cod overnight, boil 10 minutes, drain and flake.
Make a soft dough with flour, baking powder and coconut milk. Rest 20 minutes.
Roll into rounds and cook on a dry pan 4 minutes a side until puffed.
Toss the flaked cod with chopped tomato, onion, pepper, oil and lime.
Split the bakes and fill.
ways: Fried bake for a richer version
Buljol on its own as a salad
dishes.mp: Buljol keeps 2 days chilled.
prot: Extra saltfish and a boiled egg

dishes.d: Chewy cheese rolls made with cassava starch, hot from the oven.
steps: Heat the oven to 400°F (200°C).
Bring the milk, oil and salt to a boil and pour over the tapioca starch. Stir until it comes together.
Cool 10 minutes, then beat in the eggs one at a time.
Mix in the cheese and roll into balls.
Bake 18–20 minutes until puffed and golden.
ways: With a firmer cheese for more bite
dishes.mp: Freeze raw balls and bake from frozen.

dishes.d: Crisp pork in a bread roll with sweet potato and red onion salsa.
steps: Simmer the pork in salted water 30 minutes, then fry in its own fat until crisp.
Boil the sweet potato 15 minutes and slice into rounds.
Slice the onion thin and toss with lime, chilli, coriander and salt.
Split the rolls and layer sweet potato, pork and salsa.
Serve hot.
dishes.mp: Pork keeps 3 days; crisp it again in a hot pan.
light: Half the pork, extra sweet potato
prot: Extra pork and a boiled egg

dishes.d: Griddled corn cakes split and filled with soft scrambled eggs, tomato and onion.
steps: Mix the corn flour, salt and warm water into a soft dough and rest 5 minutes.
Shape into discs and griddle 6 minutes a side until a crust forms.
Fry the onion and tomato 5 minutes.
Add the beaten eggs and stir gently until just set.
Split the arepas and fill.
ways: Griddled then baked for a drier crust
Filled with cheese or beans instead
dishes.mp: Dough keeps a day; griddle fresh.
light: One arepa, two eggs, 1 tsp oil

dishes.d: Warm milk broth with a poached egg, spring onion and torn bread.
steps: Bring the milk, water and chopped spring onion to a gentle simmer.
Season with salt.
Crack the eggs in one at a time and poach 3 minutes until the whites set.
Tear the bread into bowls.
Ladle the soup over and finish with coriander.
ways: Without bread for a lighter bowl
dishes.mp: Best fresh.

dishes.d: Slow-cooked fava beans mashed with sesame oil, tomato and white cheese.
steps: Warm the beans with a little of their liquid and mash roughly.
Stir in the cumin, salt and half the sesame oil.
Top with chopped tomato and onion.
Finish with the rest of the oil, lemon and crumbled cheese.
Serve with warm flatbread.
ways: Without cheese for a vegan bowl
dishes.mp: Keeps 4 days; add water on reheating.
light: 1 tbsp oil, no cheese, one flatbread
prot: Extra cheese and a boiled egg

dishes.n: Greek yoghurt with honey and walnuts
dishes.d: Thick strained yoghurt with honey, walnuts and fruit.
steps: Spoon the yoghurt into bowls.
Toast the walnuts 3 minutes in a dry pan and chop roughly.
Slice the fruit.
Drizzle the honey over the yoghurt.
Top with walnuts, fruit and a dusting of cinnamon.
dishes.mp: Assemble fresh; toast the nuts ahead.
light: Low-fat yoghurt and half the honey

dishes.d: A soft sweet pastry with a foamy milk coffee, standing at the bar.
steps: Warm the pastries 4 minutes in a low oven.
Pull the espresso.
Steam the milk until glossy and doubled.
Pour the milk into the coffee, holding back the foam, then spoon foam on top.
Dust with cocoa and serve with the pastry.
dishes.mp: Best fresh; warm day-old pastries in the oven.

dishes.d: Crusty bread with good butter and a milky coffee.
steps: Warm the bread 5 minutes in the oven so the crust crisps.
Split and butter generously while hot.
Heat the milk until steaming.
Pour the coffee and top with the hot milk.
Serve with jam on the side.
dishes.mp: Best fresh.
prot: Add cheese and a boiled egg

dishes.d: Toasted bread rubbed with garlic and grated tomato, finished with olive oil.
steps: Toast the bread until firm and lightly coloured.
Halve a garlic clove and rub it across the hot toast.
Grate the tomatoes on the coarse side of a box grater, discarding the skins.
Spoon the tomato over the toast.
Finish with olive oil and salt.
dishes.mp: Grated tomato keeps a day chilled.
prot: Add jamón and a boiled egg

dishes.n: Tartine with jam and café au lait
dishes.d: Buttered baguette with jam, dunked into a bowl of milky coffee.
steps: Split the baguette lengthways and cut into lengths.
Butter while the bread is still fresh, then spread the jam.
Heat the milk until steaming.
Pour equal parts coffee and hot milk into wide bowls.
Serve for dunking.
dishes.mp: Best fresh.
prot: Add yoghurt and a boiled egg

dishes.d: Eggs, rashers, sausage, tomato, mushrooms and soda bread on one plate.
steps: Grill the sausages 12 minutes, turning, then the bacon 4 minutes.
Halve the tomatoes and grill cut side up.
Fry the mushrooms in butter until browned.
Fry the eggs to your liking.
Toast and butter the soda bread and plate everything together.
ways: Vegetarian with extra mushrooms and beans
dishes.mp: Best fresh.
light: Grill everything, one egg, no butter

dishes.n: Beans on toast with a poached egg
dishes.d: Hot baked beans over buttered toast with a poached egg on top.
steps: Warm the beans gently, stirring so they don't catch.
Toast the bread and butter it.
Bring a pan of water with the vinegar to a bare simmer.
Poach the eggs 3 minutes.
Spoon the beans over the toast and top with the eggs.
ways: On a jacket potato instead of toast
dishes.mp: Best fresh.

dishes.d: Flatbread baked with za'atar and olive oil, with thick strained yoghurt.
steps: Make a soft dough with flour, yeast, salt and water. Rest 1 hour.
Heat the oven to 450°F (230°C).
Roll into rounds and spread with za'atar mixed into the olive oil.
Bake 8–10 minutes until the edges colour.
Serve with labneh, cucumber and olives.
dishes.mp: Dough keeps 2 days chilled; bake fresh.
prot: Extra labneh and a boiled egg

dishes.d: Torn crisp flatbread under warm chickpeas, garlicky yoghurt and toasted pine nuts.
steps: Tear the flatbread and toast at 400°F (200°C) for 6 minutes until crisp.
Warm the chickpeas in a little of their liquid.
Whisk the yoghurt with crushed garlic, tahini, lemon and salt.
Toast the pine nuts in the butter until golden.
Layer bread, chickpeas, yoghurt sauce, then the nuts and butter.
dishes.mp: Components keep 3 days; assemble fresh.

dishes.d: Eggs baked into a cumin tomato sauce, scooped up with flatbread.
steps: Fry the onion and pepper 8 minutes until soft.
Add cumin and chilli, cook 1 minute.
Add the chopped tomatoes and simmer 12 minutes until thick.
Make wells and crack in the eggs; cover 6 minutes until set.
Serve straight from the pan with warm flatbread.
dishes.mp: Sauce keeps 4 days; add eggs fresh.

dishes.d: Soft eggs, chopped salad, cheeses, olives and bread, all on one plate.
steps: Dice the tomato, cucumber and onion very fine and dress with oil, lemon and salt.
Loosen the tahini with cold water and lemon until pourable.
Soft-scramble or fry the eggs.
Toast the bread.
Plate everything separately so each element stays distinct.
dishes.mp: Salad keeps a day; cook eggs fresh.
light: Two eggs, no bread, extra salad

dishes.d: Puffed white flatbreads with a spiced potato curry.
steps: Make a stiff dough with flour, 3 tbsp oil, salt and water. Rest 30 minutes.
Boil and cube the potatoes.
Temper the panch phoron in oil, add ginger, tomato, turmeric and chilli, cook 8 minutes.
Add the potatoes and a splash of water, simmer 10 minutes.
Roll the dough into small discs and fry 30 seconds a side until they puff.
dishes.mp: Curry keeps 3 days; fry luchi fresh.

dishes.d: Sunday breakfast: fried puri with semolina halwa and a chickpea curry.
steps: Make a stiff dough with flour, salt and water. Rest 20 minutes.
Roast the semolina in the ghee 8 minutes until it smells nutty, then add sugar and 2 cups hot water. Cook until thick.
Simmer the chickpeas with chopped tomato and garam masala 15 minutes.
Roll small discs and fry 30 seconds a side until puffed.
Serve all three together.
dishes.mp: Chana keeps 4 days; fry puri fresh.

dishes.n: Tamago kake gohan with miso soup
dishes.d: Hot rice with a raw egg stirred through, soy sauce, and a bowl of miso soup.
steps: Serve the hot rice into bowls.
Crack an egg over each and add a spoon of soy sauce.
Stir hard and fast so the heat of the rice thickens the egg.
Heat the dashi, cube the tofu in, and whisk in the miso off the boil.
Top both with spring onion and torn nori.
ways: Yolk only for a richer bowl
Egg lightly cooked if you'd rather not eat it raw
dishes.mp: Dashi keeps 3 days; assemble fresh.

dishes.d: Rice with a fried egg, sesame oil and soy, with kimchi on the side.
steps: Fry the eggs in a little sesame oil with crisp edges and a soft yolk.
Serve the hot rice into bowls.
Top each with an egg, a spoon of soy and a drizzle of sesame oil.
Add kimchi to the side.
Finish with spring onion, sesame seeds and torn seaweed.
dishes.mp: Kimchi keeps for weeks; cook eggs fresh.

dishes.d: Silky rice porridge with minced pork balls, ginger and a soft egg.
steps: Simmer the rice in the stock 30–35 minutes, stirring, until the grains break down.
Season the pork with soy and pepper and roll into small balls.
Drop them into the congee and cook 6 minutes.
Crack in the eggs and let them set softly in the heat.
Top with ginger, spring onion, coriander and more soy.
dishes.mp: Congee keeps 3 days and thickens; loosen with stock.

dishes.d: Chocolate rice porridge, eaten sweet with salty dried fish alongside.
steps: Boil the rice in the water 20 minutes, stirring, until thick and sticky.
Stir in the cocoa and sugar and cook 5 more minutes.
Fry the dried fish in the oil until crisp.
Serve the porridge hot with milk poured over.
Eat with the salty fish on the side.
dishes.mp: Keeps 3 days; loosen with milk.
prot: Extra fish and a boiled egg

dishes.d: Chicken simmered in palm nut pulp with onion, chilli and greens.
steps: Season and brown the chicken in the oil.
Add the sliced onion and tomato and cook 8 minutes.
Stir in the palm nut pulp with 2 cups of water.
Simmer 35 minutes until the sauce reduces and the oil rises.
Add the spinach and chilli for the last 5 minutes, season and serve with rice.
ways: Chicken thighs only for a richer sauce
dishes.mp: Keeps 4 days, freezes 2 months.
prot: Extra chicken and a boiled egg

dishes.d: Warm steamed cassava bread with mashed avocado and chilli salt.
steps: Steam the cassava bread 8 minutes until soft and hot.
Mash the avocado with lime and salt.
Chop the tomato and chilli finely and stir through.
Slice the bread.
Spread the avocado over and finish with chilli salt.
dishes.mp: Cassava bread keeps 3 days wrapped.
prot: Add a boiled egg and peanuts

dishes.d: Cassava leaves cooked down with peanut, coconut and prawns.
steps: Simmer the cassava leaves in water 25 minutes until tender.
Add the onion and garlic and cook 5 minutes.
Stir in the peanut flour and coconut milk.
Simmer 10 minutes, then add the prawns for 5 minutes.
Season and serve with rice.
dishes.mp: Keeps 3 days chilled.
light: Light coconut milk, more rice vegetables

dishes.d: Toasted sweet bread with cashew butter and warm spiced tea.
steps: Toast the bread until golden.
Spread with cashew butter while warm.
Slice the banana over the top.
Simmer the milk with the tea and cinnamon 4 minutes.
Serve together.
dishes.mp: Best fresh.

dishes.d: Breakfast spaghetti tossed with smoked herring, peppers and epis.
steps: Soak the herring in hot water 10 minutes, then drain and flake.
Boil the spaghetti until just tender and drain.
Fry the onion and pepper in the oil, add tomato paste and epis, cook 5 minutes.
Add the herring and a splash of water.
Toss the spaghetti through and season.
dishes.mp: Keeps 2 days; reheat in a pan.

dishes.d: Steamed couscous under a spiced tomato broth with fish and vegetables.
steps: Fry the onion in the oil, stir in the harissa, tomato paste and caraway.
Add 6 cups of water, the chickpeas and the hard vegetables. Simmer 25 minutes.
Steam the couscous over the broth twice, fluffing between.
Add the fish to the broth for the last 10 minutes.
Mound the couscous and ladle the broth, fish and vegetables over.
dishes.mp: Broth keeps 3 days and improves.

dishes.d: Rice slow-cooked over lamb, carrot and cumin until every grain takes the fat.
steps: Heat the oil in a heavy pot and brown the lamb hard on all sides.
Add the sliced onion, cook 8 minutes, then the carrot for 10 more.
Add cumin, salt and water to cover by an inch. Simmer 30 minutes.
Level the rice on top without stirring, add water to a finger above the rice, and bury the whole garlic head.
Boil until the water drops to the rice, then cover and steam on low 25 minutes. Mix from the bottom to serve.
ways: Vegetarian with chickpeas and extra carrot
dishes.pair: Tomato and onion salad, green tea.
dishes.mp: Keeps 4 days; reheat covered with a splash of water.
prot: Extra lamb and a boiled egg

dishes.d: Meat and potatoes fried down slowly with onion until everything browns together.
steps: Brown the meat in the oil over high heat until well coloured.
Add the sliced onion and cook 10 minutes until soft and golden.
Add a cup of water, the bay and pepper, cover and simmer 25 minutes.
Add the cubed potato and cook 20 minutes until tender and the liquid has gone.
Season and finish with plenty of dill.
ways: With a little broth left as a stew
dishes.mp: Keeps 4 days; better the next day.

dishes.d: Bread boat filled with molten cheese, finished with a yolk and butter.
steps: Make a soft dough with flour, yeast, salt and warm milk. Rest 1 hour.
Heat the oven to 450°F (230°C).
Shape each piece into an oval and pinch the ends into a boat.
Fill with cheese and bake 15 minutes until the crust colours.
Drop a yolk and a knob of butter into each and return for 3 minutes. Stir it together at the table.
dishes.mp: Dough keeps 2 days chilled; bake fresh.

dishes.d: Cold soured milk with cucumber, radish and a lot of herbs.
steps: Whisk the yoghurt with the cold water until smooth and pourable.
Dice the cucumber and radish very small.
Chop all the herbs and spring onion finely.
Stir everything through the yoghurt and salt well.
Chill 20 minutes and serve cold, with bread.
ways: With a boiled egg chopped in
dishes.mp: Best the day it's made.

dishes.n: Toast with avocado and poached eggs
dishes.d: Sourdough with smashed avocado, poached eggs, lemon and chilli.
steps: Toast the sourdough.
Smash the avocado with lemon, salt and pepper.
Poach the eggs 3 minutes in barely simmering water.
Spread the avocado thickly on the toast and top with rocket.
Add the eggs, then oil, chilli and a last squeeze of lemon.
dishes.mp: Best fresh.
light: One slice, one egg, half an avocado

dishes.d: Fish fillets grilled hard and fast with lemon, over a crunchy salad.
steps: Pat the fillets dry, oil and season them well.
Grill skin side down 5 minutes without moving them, then 2 minutes on the flesh.
Shave the fennel, cucumber and onion very thin.
Dress the leaves and shaved vegetables with oil, lemon and capers.
Serve the fish on the salad with lemon halves.
dishes.pair: Crusty bread, cold white wine or sparkling water.
dishes.mp: Salad keeps a day undressed; cook fish fresh.

dishes.d: Slow-roast lamb shoulder with sweet potato, pumpkin and rosemary.
steps: Heat the oven to 325°F (160°C).
Season the lamb hard and sear it in the oil on all sides.
Put it in a roasting tin with the stock, garlic and rosemary, cover with foil and roast 2 hours.
Add the chunked kūmara and pumpkin for the last 45 minutes, uncovered.
Rest the lamb 15 minutes, then pull it apart and serve with the roots.
ways: Grilled lamb chops for a quicker version
dishes.mp: Keeps 3 days; excellent cold in sandwiches.

dishes.d: Raw fish cured in lime and folded through coconut cream with chilli and onion.
steps: Cube the fish small and cover with lime juice. Chill 30 minutes until it turns opaque.
Drain off most of the lime juice.
Dice the onion, tomato, cucumber and chilli finely.
Fold everything through the coconut cream and salt well.
Chill 20 minutes and serve cold, in coconut shells or bowls.
dishes.mp: Eat the day it's made.

dishes.d: The everyday plate: rice, beans, salad, plantain and a piece of meat or fish.
steps: Season and grill the chicken or fish 6 minutes a side.
Warm the beans with a little of their liquid.
Fry the plantain slices until caramelised.
Shred the cabbage and dress it with lime, oil and salt.
Plate everything in its own section rather than mixed.
ways: Vegetarian with extra beans and egg
dishes.mp: Components keep 3 days; plate fresh.
prot: Extra chicken and a boiled egg

dishes.d: Chicken browned in caramelised sugar then stewed with peppers and olives.
ing: salt, oregano and lime to taste
steps: Marinate the chicken in lime, oregano, salt and sofrito for 30 minutes.
Melt the sugar in the oil until it darkens, then add the chicken and turn to coat.
Brown well, then add the onion, pepper and tomato paste.
Add a cup of water and the olives, cover and simmer 30 minutes.
Serve over white rice with the sauce spooned over.
ways: Without the sugar for a lighter stew
dishes.mp: Keeps 4 days and improves overnight.

dishes.d: Smoked fish simmered with tomato, onion and sweet pepper, spooned over plain rice.
steps: Rinse the smoked fish in hot water and flake off the bones.
Fry the onion, garlic and pepper in the oil for 6 minutes.
Add the blended tomato and cook down 12 minutes until it darkens.
Return the fish, add a cup of water and simmer 12 minutes.
Serve over rice.
ways: With less oil and more tomato
dishes.mp: Keeps 3 days; the flavour deepens.
prot: Extra fish and a boiled egg

dishes.d: Green bananas cooked in one pot with beans, tomato and onion until soft and stewy.
steps: Peel the bananas under running water and cut into chunks.
Fry the onion, garlic and tomato in the oil for 6 minutes.
Add the curry powder, beans and a cup of water.
Add the bananas, cover and cook 20 minutes until tender.
Mash a few pieces to thicken the pot.
ways: With beef for a heavier plate
dishes.mp: Keeps 3 days.
light: 1 tbsp oil, more beans than banana

dishes.d: Finely chopped jute leaves cooked into a green broth, poured over rice with chicken.
ing: 500 g molokhia leaves, frozen or fresh
steps: Simmer the chicken with the onion in 6 cups of water for 30 minutes and keep the broth.
Chop the molokhia very finely or use it frozen and chopped.
Bring the broth to a simmer and stir the leaves through for 5 minutes without boiling hard.
Fry the crushed garlic with the coriander in the ghee until fragrant and pour it into the pot.
Serve over rice with the chicken and lemon.
dishes.mp: Keeps 3 days; do not boil hard when reheating.

dishes.d: Okra slow-cooked with tomato, garlic and lamb or chicken until glossy.
steps: Brown the meat in the oil for 8 minutes.
Add the onion and garlic and cook 5 minutes.
Stir in the blended tomato and simmer 15 minutes.
Add the trimmed okra and cook 12 minutes until tender, not slimy.
Serve with rice.
dishes.mp: Keeps 3 days.
prot: Extra meat and a side of beans

dishes.d: Hot chickpea broth poured over torn bread with cumin, garlic and harissa.
steps: Simmer the chickpeas in their liquid with the crushed garlic and cumin for 15 minutes.
Tear the bread into deep bowls.
Whisk harissa, lemon and olive oil into a spoonful of the broth.
Ladle the chickpeas and broth over the bread.
Top with a poached or soft-boiled egg.
ways: Without bread for a lighter bowl
dishes.mp: Broth keeps 3 days; add bread fresh.

dishes.d: Pumpkin leaves stewed in groundnut flour and tomato, with firm maize porridge.
steps: Whisk the maize flour into simmering water and stir until thick and smooth, about 12 minutes.
Strip and shred the pumpkin leaves and rinse them well.
Fry the onion and tomato in the oil for 6 minutes.
Add the leaves with a splash of water and cook 6 minutes.
Stir in the groundnut flour and beans and cook 5 minutes more.
dishes.mp: Relish keeps 3 days.
prot: Extra beans and a boiled egg

dishes.d: Firm maize meal with stewed greens and tomato beans.
steps: Stir the maize meal into simmering water and beat until thick and smooth, about 15 minutes.
Fry the onion and garlic 5 minutes.
Add the tomato and cook down 6 minutes.
Add the beans and shredded greens with a splash of water and cook 8 minutes.
Serve alongside the sadza.
ways: With peanut butter stirred into the greens
With beef for a heavier plate
dishes.mp: Relish keeps 3 days.

dishes.d: Shredded beef slow-cooked with peppers, onion, cumin and tomato, over rice.
steps: Simmer the beef in salted water for 45 minutes, then shred and keep the broth.
Fry the onion, pepper and garlic in the oil for 8 minutes.
Add the cumin and tomato and cook 10 minutes.
Return the beef with a cup of broth and simmer 15 minutes.
Serve over rice.
dishes.mp: Keeps 4 days and freezes well.
light: Lean beef, 1 tbsp oil, half the rice

dishes.d: The everyday plate: rice, stewed red beans and braised chicken with salad.
steps: Season the chicken with oregano, lime and salt and brown in the oil.
Add onion, pepper and tomato and cook 6 minutes.
Add a cup of water, cover and braise 25 minutes.
Simmer the beans with a little of the sofrito until thick.
Serve with rice and a green salad.
ways: Beans only for a meat-free plate
dishes.mp: Beans and chicken keep 3 days.

dishes.d: A thick vegetable stew of aubergine, cabbage, carrot and chayote over rice.
steps: Chop all the vegetables roughly.
Fry the onion and garlic in the oil for 5 minutes.
Add the harder vegetables and cook 10 minutes.
Add the tomato, aubergine and a cup of water and simmer 20 minutes.
Mash lightly, finish with lime and serve with rice.
ways: With beef or crab for a heavier pot
dishes.mp: Keeps 4 days and improves overnight.
light: 1 tbsp oil, more vegetables than rice

dishes.d: Rice cooked with pigeon peas, sofrito and olives until every grain is seasoned.
steps: Fry the sofrito and tomato paste in the oil for 4 minutes.
Add the oregano, olives and pigeon peas and stir 2 minutes.
Add the rice and coat it in the sofrito.
Pour in the water, bring to a boil, then cover and cook 20 minutes on low.
Fluff and rest 5 minutes.
ways: With less oil and extra peas
dishes.mp: Keeps 4 days.
prot: Add chicken thigh and extra peas

dishes.d: Soft fried flatbreads filled with curried chickpeas and tamarind.
steps: Mix the flour, yeast, turmeric, salt and warm water into a soft dough and prove 1 hour.
Fry the onion, garlic and curry powder for 4 minutes.
Add the chickpeas and a cup of water and simmer 15 minutes until thick.
Flatten small pieces of dough and fry 30 seconds a side.
Sandwich the chickpeas between two breads with tamarind.
dishes.mp: Channa keeps 3 days; bread is best fresh.
prot: Extra chickpeas and a boiled egg

dishes.d: The Brazilian working lunch: rice, black beans, grilled chicken and salad.
steps: Season the chicken with lime, garlic and salt and rest 10 minutes.
Fry half the onion and garlic, add the beans and a cup of their liquid, simmer 15 minutes.
Cook the rice with the rest of the onion and garlic.
Grill the chicken 5 minutes a side.
Plate with a tomato and lettuce salad.
ways: Beans and egg for a meat-free plate
dishes.mp: Beans keep 4 days; grill the chicken fresh.

dishes.d: Chicken and three kinds of potato simmered with guascas until the broth thickens.
steps: Simmer the chicken with the onion in 2 litres of water for 25 minutes, then shred.
Add the floury potatoes and cook 20 minutes until they break down.
Add the waxy and new potatoes with the corn and cook 15 minutes.
Stir in the guascas and the shredded chicken.
Serve with a spoon of cream and sliced avocado.
dishes.mp: Keeps 3 days; add cream when serving.

dishes.d: A long-simmered beef and root vegetable soup, served with rice.
steps: Simmer the beef with onion, garlic and salt for 45 minutes.
Add the cassava and carrot and cook 15 minutes.
Add the chayote, corn and plantain and cook 12 minutes more.
Check the seasoning and skim the broth.
Serve the broth and vegetables with rice on the side.
dishes.mp: Keeps 4 days and tastes better on day two.
prot: Extra beef and a boiled egg

dishes.d: Shredded beef, black beans, rice and a little sweet plantain on one plate.
steps: Simmer the beef 40 minutes in salted water, then shred.
Fry the onion, pepper and garlic 6 minutes, add the tomato and cook 8 minutes.
Return the beef with a little broth and simmer 10 minutes.
Warm the beans with a spoon of the sofrito.
Griddle the plantain and plate everything with rice.
dishes.mp: Beef and beans keep 4 days.

dishes.d: Tuna, green beans, potato, egg and olives dressed with olive oil and lemon.
steps: Boil the potatoes 15 minutes and the beans 4 minutes, then cool both.
Soft-boil the eggs for 7 minutes and halve them.
Whisk the oil, lemon and mustard into a dressing.
Toss the vegetables with most of the dressing.
Top with tuna, eggs and olives and finish with the rest.
dishes.mp: Prep components a day ahead; dress on the plate.

dishes.d: The everyday Greek bean soup: white beans, carrot, celery and good olive oil.
steps: Soften the onion, carrot, celery and garlic in half the oil for 8 minutes.
Add the tomato and oregano and cook 5 minutes.
Add the beans and 3 cups of water and simmer 25 minutes.
Mash a ladleful to thicken the soup.
Finish with the rest of the oil and a squeeze of lemon.
dishes.mp: Keeps 4 days and freezes well.
prot: Extra beans and a side of feta

dishes.d: Mashed potato folded through buttery cabbage and spring onion, with an egg on top.
steps: Boil the potatoes 20 minutes until tender and drain.
Wilt the shredded cabbage in a little water for 5 minutes.
Warm the milk with the spring onion.
Mash the potato with the milk and butter, then fold in the cabbage.
Poach the eggs 3 minutes and serve on top.
ways: With olive oil instead of butter
dishes.mp: Keeps 2 days; reheat in a pan.

dishes.d: Borlotti beans and small pasta in a soft tomato and rosemary broth.
steps: Soften the onion, carrot, celery and garlic in the oil for 8 minutes.
Add the rosemary and tomato and cook 6 minutes.
Add the beans and 4 cups of water and simmer 15 minutes.
Blend a third of the pot and return it for body.
Add the pasta and cook until just tender.
dishes.mp: Keeps 3 days; add a splash of water when reheating.
prot: Extra beans and grated hard cheese

dishes.d: Potato soup with finely shredded kale and olive oil, with chicken on the side.
steps: Simmer the potato, onion and garlic in 5 cups of water for 20 minutes.
Blend until smooth and season well.
Shred the kale as finely as you can and add it to the pot.
Simmer 5 minutes so it stays bright green.
Grill the lemon-seasoned chicken 5 minutes a side and serve alongside.
ways: Soup only for a lighter meal
dishes.mp: Soup keeps 4 days; add kale when reheating.

dishes.d: Brown lentils stewed with carrot, potato, pepper and smoked paprika.
steps: Soften the onion, pepper and garlic in the oil for 8 minutes.
Stir in the paprika off the heat so it does not burn.
Add the lentils, carrot, potato, bay leaf and 5 cups of water.
Simmer 30 minutes until the lentils are soft and the broth thickens.
Season and rest 10 minutes before serving.
ways: Blended smooth for a thick soup
dishes.mp: Keeps 4 days and improves overnight.
prot: Extra lentils and a boiled egg

dishes.n: Jacket potato with beans and cheese
dishes.d: A baked potato split and filled with baked beans and grated cheese.
steps: Prick the potatoes, rub with oil and salt.
Bake at 200C for 55 minutes until the skin is crisp.
Warm the beans gently.
Split the potatoes and fluff the insides with a fork.
Fill with beans, top with cheese and spring onion.
ways: With cottage cheese for more protein
dishes.mp: Bake two extra; they reheat well.

dishes.d: Spiced rice cooked in chicken broth with tomato, dried lime and warm spices.
steps: Brown the chicken in the oil and set aside.
Fry the onion and garlic 8 minutes, add the spice and tomato and cook 6 minutes.
Return the chicken with the dried limes and 4 cups of water and simmer 25 minutes.
Lift out the chicken, add the rinsed rice to the broth and cook 18 minutes covered.
Grill the chicken briefly and serve on the rice.
dishes.mp: Keeps 3 days; rice reheats with a splash of water.
prot: Extra chicken and a side of yoghurt

dishes.d: Lentils and rice cooked together, topped with deeply caramelised onions.
steps: Boil the lentils 15 minutes until almost tender.
Fry the sliced onion in the oil slowly for 20 minutes until dark and sweet.
Add the rice, cumin and 2 cups of water to the lentils and cook 18 minutes covered.
Fold half the onion through and rest 10 minutes.
Top with the rest and serve with a lemon-dressed cucumber and tomato salad.
dishes.mp: Keeps 4 days.
prot: Add yoghurt and a boiled egg

dishes.d: Smooth red lentil soup with mint and lemon, alongside a tomato bulgur pilaf.
steps: Soften half the onion and the carrot in a little oil for 6 minutes.
Add the lentils and 5 cups of water and simmer 20 minutes.
Blend smooth and season, then finish with mint and lemon.
For the pilaf, fry the rest of the onion with the tomato paste, add the bulgur and 3 cups of water.
Cover and cook 15 minutes, then rest 5 minutes and fluff.
dishes.mp: Both keep 3 days.

dishes.d: Hand-pulled noodles in a peppery broth with beef, peppers and tomato.
steps: Brown the beef hard in the oil for 6 minutes.
Add the onion, garlic and pepper and cook 6 minutes.
Add the tomato and cumin and cook down 8 minutes.
Pour in 5 cups of water and simmer 20 minutes.
Cook the noodles, divide into bowls and ladle the broth over with coriander.
dishes.mp: Broth keeps 3 days; cook noodles fresh.

dishes.d: Rice with thin masoor dal and slices of pan-fried aubergine.
steps: Boil the lentils with turmeric and salt for 20 minutes until soft.
Temper the panch phoron, garlic and chilli in a little oil and pour over the dal.
Slice the aubergine, salt it and rest 10 minutes.
Fry the slices 3 minutes a side until golden.
Serve with rice.
ways: Dal and rice only for a lighter plate
dishes.mp: Dal keeps 3 days.

dishes.d: Chicken and onion simmered in dashi and soy, set with egg over rice.
steps: Cook the rice.
Simmer the dashi, soy and mirin with the sliced onion for 4 minutes.
Add the sliced chicken and cook 6 minutes.
Pour the beaten egg over in a spiral and cover for 90 seconds, leaving it just set.
Slide onto the rice and scatter spring onion.
dishes.mp: Best fresh; the broth base keeps 3 days.
prot: Extra chicken and an extra egg

dishes.d: A bubbling soybean-paste stew with tofu, courgette and mushroom.
steps: Bring 4 cups of water to a simmer and whisk in the doenjang.
Add the onion, garlic and gochugaru and cook 6 minutes.
Add the courgette and mushroom and cook 6 minutes.
Add the cubed tofu and simmer 5 minutes without stirring hard.
Finish with spring onion and serve with rice.
ways: With pork belly for a richer pot
dishes.mp: Keeps 3 days.

dishes.d: Clear ginger broth with chicken, green papaya and chilli leaves.
steps: Fry the ginger, garlic and onion in the oil for 4 minutes.
Add the chicken and brown 6 minutes.
Add the fish sauce and 6 cups of water and simmer 20 minutes.
Add the papaya and cook 10 minutes until tender.
Stir the leaves in at the end and serve with rice.
ways: With rice washing for a cloudier broth
dishes.mp: Keeps 3 days; add greens when reheating.

dishes.d: Minced chicken stir-fried hard with chilli, garlic and holy basil, with a fried egg.
steps: Pound the garlic and chilli into a rough paste.
Get the pan very hot, add 1 tbsp oil and the paste for 20 seconds.
Add the mince and fry hard for 4 minutes without stirring too often.
Add the sauces and sugar, then the basil, and toss until it wilts.
Fry the eggs in the rest of the oil and serve over rice.
dishes.mp: Best fresh; mince keeps 2 days.

dishes.n: Barramundi with kumara mash and greens
dishes.d: Pan-roasted fish with sweet potato mash and lemon-dressed greens.
steps: Boil the sweet potato 20 minutes and mash with a little oil and salt.
Season the fish and pan-roast skin-down 4 minutes, then turn for 2.
Steam the beans and broccolini 4 minutes.
Toss the greens with garlic, lemon and a little oil.
Plate the fish on the mash with the greens alongside.
dishes.mp: Mash keeps 3 days; cook the fish fresh.

dishes.d: A crisp grated-potato cake topped with a fried egg and a sharp green salad.
steps: Parboil the potatoes 8 minutes, cool, then coarsely grate them.
Season and press into a hot buttered pan in an even layer.
Cook 10 minutes a side until deeply golden.
Fry the eggs in the oil.
Dress the salad with vinegar and oil and serve alongside.
dishes.mp: Grate the potato fresh; rösti reheats in a pan.

dishes.d: Macaroni and potato baked with a little cheese and soft onions, with apple sauce.
steps: Boil the diced potato 10 minutes, add the macaroni and cook until just tender.
Fry the sliced onion slowly in the butter for 15 minutes until sweet and brown.
Drain the pasta and potato and fold through the warm milk and cheese.
Season with nutmeg and pepper and top with the onions.
Stew the apples with a splash of water for 10 minutes and serve on the side.
ways: With half the cheese and extra potato
dishes.mp: Keeps 3 days; reheat with a splash of milk.
prot: Extra cheese and a side of ham

dishes.d: Pita filled with fried aubergine, boiled egg, salad, tahini and amba.
steps: Slice and salt the aubergine, rest 10 minutes, then pat dry.
Fry or roast the slices until soft and browned.
Boil the eggs 9 minutes and slice.
Loosen the tahini with lemon and cold water until pourable.
Fill the pita with salad, aubergine and egg and finish with tahini and amba.
ways: In a bowl over rice instead of pita
dishes.mp: Aubergine and eggs keep 3 days.

dishes.n: Israeli salad with labneh and egg
dishes.d: Finely diced cucumber and tomato with olive oil, thick labneh and a soft egg.
steps: Dice the cucumber, tomato and onion as small as you can manage.
Chop the parsley and fold it through.
Dress with lemon, oil and salt just before eating.
Soft-boil the eggs for 7 minutes.
Spread labneh on the plate, pile the salad on and add the halved eggs.
ways: Without labneh for a lighter plate
dishes.mp: Dress it at the table; it waters if it sits.

dishes.d: Kidney beans stewed with walnut, coriander and blue fenugreek, with corn bread.
steps: Fry the onion and garlic in the oil for 6 minutes.
Add the beans with a cup of their liquid and simmer 15 minutes.
Pound the walnuts with coriander, fenugreek and vinegar and stir through.
Mash roughly so some beans stay whole.
Mix the cornmeal with hot water and salt, shape into flat cakes and griddle 5 minutes a side.
dishes.mp: Keeps 4 days and improves overnight.
prot: Extra beans and a boiled egg

dishes.d: Chicken stewed down with a lot of onion, tomato and fresh herbs.
steps: Brown the chicken dry in a hot pan for 8 minutes and set aside.
Add the sliced onion with the oil and cook 15 minutes until collapsing.
Add the tomato and garlic and cook 10 minutes.
Return the chicken, cover and stew 15 minutes.
Stir in the chopped herbs and fenugreek off the heat.
dishes.mp: Keeps 3 days.
prot: Extra chicken and beans on the side

dishes.d: Small soft fried breads with dried curd, butter and milk tea.
steps: Mix the flour, yeast, sugar, salt and warm milk into a soft dough and prove 1 hour.
Cut into small squares or rounds.
Fry in hot oil 90 seconds a side until puffed and golden.
Brew strong tea and top with hot milk.
Serve the baursak with qurt or soft curd.
ways: With cottage cheese instead of qurt
dishes.mp: Dough keeps a day in the fridge.
prot: Extra curd and a boiled egg

dishes.d: Clear lamb or beef broth with potato, carrot and wide noodles.
ing: 700 g lamb or beef on the bone
steps: Cover the meat with cold water, bring to a boil and skim carefully.
Add the onion, bay and peppercorns and simmer 45 minutes.
Add the potato and carrot and cook 15 minutes.
Cook the noodles separately and divide into bowls.
Ladle the broth and meat over and finish with dill.
ways: Without noodles for a lighter bowl
dishes.mp: Broth keeps 4 days and freezes well.

dishes.d: Clear chicken broth with ginger and star anise, rice noodles and a pile of herbs.
steps: Char the halved onion and ginger under a grill for 5 minutes.
Cover the chicken with 3 litres of water, bring to a bare simmer and skim.
Add the charred aromatics and spices and simmer 45 minutes.
Lift out the chicken, shred it, and season the broth with fish sauce.
Soak the noodles, divide into bowls with chicken, and ladle the hot broth over with herbs and lime.
ways: Without noodles for a lighter bowl
dishes.mp: Broth keeps 4 days and freezes; assemble fresh.

dishes.d: A crisp baguette filled with fried egg, pickled carrot, cucumber and coriander.
steps: Shred the carrot and daikon and pickle in the vinegar and sugar for 20 minutes.
Fry the eggs in the oil, keeping the yolks soft.
Warm and split the baguettes.
Layer in the egg, drained pickle and sliced cucumber.
Finish with coriander and a little pickling liquid.
dishes.mp: Pickle keeps a week.

dishes.d: Roasted sweet potato crisped in a pan with spinach and a poached egg on top.
steps: Dice the kumara and roast at 200C for 20 minutes.
Fry the onion in the oil for 5 minutes, then add the kumara and paprika and crisp it 5 minutes.
Wilt the spinach through at the end.
Poach the eggs 3 minutes.
Serve the hash topped with eggs and a squeeze of lemon.
dishes.mp: Roast the kumara ahead; keeps 3 days.

dishes.n: Grilled fish with kumara and greens
dishes.d: Simple grilled white fish with roast kumara and steamed greens.
steps: Roast the kumara wedges at 200C with a little oil for 25 minutes.
Season the fish and grill 4 minutes a side.
Steam the broccolini and beans 4 minutes.
Toss the greens with garlic, lemon and a little oil.
Plate everything with the lemon alongside.
dishes.mp: Kumara keeps 3 days; cook the fish fresh.

dishes.d: Blanched vegetables, tofu and egg under a thick peanut and lime sauce.
ing: 1 cup peanut butter or ground peanuts
steps: Boil the potatoes 15 minutes and blanch the beans, cabbage and sprouts for 2 minutes each.
Fry or bake the tofu until golden.
Boil the eggs 9 minutes and halve them.
Loosen the peanut butter with hot water, lime, kecap manis and a little chilli until pourable.
Arrange everything on a platter and pour the sauce over.
ways: With tempeh as well as tofu
dishes.mp: Sauce keeps 5 days; blanch vegetables fresh.

dishes.d: Turmeric chicken soup with glass noodles, egg, bean sprouts and fried shallot.
steps: Simmer the chicken in 2.5 litres of water for 30 minutes, then shred.
Blend the turmeric, ginger, garlic and nuts and fry the paste 3 minutes.
Add the paste and bruised lemongrass to the broth and simmer 15 minutes.
Soak the noodles and boil the eggs 9 minutes.
Fill bowls with noodles, sprouts, chicken and egg and ladle the broth over.
dishes.mp: Broth keeps 4 days.

dishes.d: A light Fiji-Indian fish curry with tomato, turmeric and curry leaves, over rice.
steps: Fry the onion, garlic, ginger and curry leaves in a little oil for 6 minutes.
Add the turmeric and curry powder and cook 1 minute.
Add the chopped tomato and a cup of water and simmer 10 minutes.
Slide the fish in and simmer 8 minutes without stirring much.
Serve over rice with lime.
dishes.mp: Best within a day.

dishes.d: Soft flatbread wrapped around thick yellow dhal and a little pickle.
steps: Mix the flour, a little oil, salt and water into a soft dough and rest 20 minutes.
Boil the split peas with turmeric for 25 minutes until thick.
Temper the cumin, garlic, onion and chilli and stir into the dhal.
Roll the dough thin and cook on a hot dry pan 1 minute a side.
Spoon the dhal on, add pickle and roll it up.
ways: Dhal in a bowl with roti on the side
With extra vegetables in the dhal
dishes.mp: Dhal keeps 4 days; roti is best fresh.
prot: Extra dhal and a boiled egg

snacks.how: Mix 2 cups flour, ¼ cup sugar, ½ tsp nutmeg, 3 tbsp butter, 1 egg and ⅓ cup milk into a stiff dough. Roll thin, cut into small squares and fry at 350°F (175°C) until golden, or bake at 350°F for 15–18 minutes, stirring once.
Mix 2 cups flour, 2 tsp yeast, ⅓ cup sugar, ¼ tsp nutmeg and 1¼ cups warm water into a sticky batter. Rise 45–60 minutes. Drop spoonfuls into 350°F (175°C) oil and fry until golden all over.

Blend soaked, peeled black-eyed peas with onion and pepper with very little water, whisk 3 minutes to add air, salt, then fry spoonfuls at 350°F (175°C). Air-fry version: 375°F (190°C), 12–14 minutes on a greased tray.
Grind roasted peanuts with ginger, chili and salt, squeeze out the oil, shape into sticks or rings and fry or bake until crunchy.
Slice green plantain paper-thin, season with salt, and fry at 350°F (175°C) 2–3 minutes. Baked: toss with 1 tsp oil, 375°F (190°C), 15–20 minutes, flipping halfway.
Cube ripe plantain, toss with blended ginger, onion, chili, cloves and salt. Fry until caramelized, or air-fry at 390°F (200°C) for 12–14 minutes. Serve with roasted groundnuts.
Like puff-puff with a touch more sugar and nutmeg: mix flour, yeast, sugar, nutmeg and warm water, rise 1 hour, fry spoonfuls until deep golden.
Roast a ripe (or half-ripe) plantain in its skin over a flame or grill, or in the oven at 425°F (220°C) for 25 minutes. Peel and eat with roasted groundnuts or pepper sauce.
Roast fresh corn on the cob over a grill or gas flame, turning, until charred in spots (10–12 minutes). Eat with fresh coconut pieces or 'ube' (African pear).
Fill shortcrust pastry circles with a cooked mince, potato, carrot and onion filling seasoned with curry and thyme. Seal with a fork, brush with egg and bake at 375°F (190°C) for 25–30 minutes.
Cook grated fresh coconut with sugar and a splash of water, stirring, until the sugar caramelizes and coats the coconut (10–15 minutes). Spoon into small mounds and let set.
Eat fresh, or soak dried ones overnight. Blend soaked tiger nuts with dates and water and strain for kunun aya (tiger nut milk).
Boil 1 cup dried hibiscus leaves with ginger, pineapple peel and cloves in 8 cups water for 20 minutes. Strain, sweeten lightly (or with pineapple juice), chill.
Ferment corn 2–3 days, boil into a light porridge, strain, and mix with caramelized sugar syrup. Serve chilled.
Cube ripe plantain and fry in palm or vegetable oil until golden. Serve with a chili, onion and tomato sauce. Air-fry: 390°F (200°C), 12 minutes.
Eat a ripe banana with a handful of roasted groundnuts. Simple and filling.
Cube ripe pawpaw (papaya) and pineapple and squeeze over lime.
Mix flour, sugar, baking powder, nutmeg, egg and milk into a thick batter. Fry spoonfuls at 325°F (165°C) slowly so the middle cooks, until dark golden.
Thin beef slices coated in yaji spice, grilled 3–4 minutes per side, dusted with more yaji. Serve with sliced onion.
Mix flour, sugar, yeast, cardamom and coconut milk into a soft dough. Rise 1 hour, roll, cut into triangles and fry until puffed and golden.
Fill pastry triangles with spiced ground beef or lentils, onion and chili. Fry until crisp or bake at 400°F (200°C) for 18–20 minutes.
Pit Medjool dates and fill each with a walnut half. Dust with cinnamon.
Stretch semolina-flour dough thin, oil and fold into a square, flatten and cook on a griddle 3 minutes per side. Drizzle with honey.
Make chin chin with half chickpea flour and half wheat flour, less sugar, and bake at 350°F (175°C) for 15 minutes for a higher-protein, lower-oil version.
Store-bought is easiest. Homemade: marinate beef strips in vinegar, coriander, pepper and salt, then air-dry in a biltong box for 4–7 days.
Boil peeled cassava 15 minutes, then roast at 425°F (220°C) with a little oil and salt for 20 minutes until crisp.
Slice an apple and dip in natural peanut butter. Sprinkle cinnamon.
Top plain Greek yogurt with berries and a drizzle of honey.
Blend chickpeas, tahini, lemon, garlic and a splash of water until smooth. Dip carrots, cucumber and peppers.
Boil eggs 9–10 minutes, cool in cold water, peel. Season with salt and pepper or shito.
Pop ⅓ cup kernels in an air popper or covered pot with 1 tsp oil. Season with salt or chili.

Slice lean beef thin, dry it in the sun or a 170°F (75°C) oven for 3 hours, coat in yaji (ground peanut, chili, ginger and spices) mixed with a little oil, then dry or grill again until firm and fragrant.

Soak millet or sorghum overnight, blend with ginger, cloves and chili, steep and sieve. Cook the starch into a thin porridge, stir back into the liquid, sweeten lightly with sugar or dates and serve cold.
Put 4 tbsp garri in a cup of cold water, stir and let it swell 2 minutes. Add 2 tbsp roasted groundnuts, 1 tsp sugar and a splash of milk. Eat right away; the garri keeps swelling.

advanced: 10 min warm-up, 20 min tempo, 10 min cool-down

beginner: 30 s on / 30 s off: jumping jacks, squats, mountain climbers, high knees
intermediate: 40/20: burpees, kettlebell swings, jump squats, push-ups, bike sprint
advanced: EMOM 20 min: 10 KB swings, 8 burpees, 12 wall balls, 200 m row (rotate)

about.water: Needs vary with body size, heat and activity. The National Academies suggest about 3.7 L (125 fl oz) a day for men and 2.7 L (91 fl oz) for women, counting all drinks and food.
about.steps: More daily steps are linked with a lower risk of early death. In a 2022 analysis of 15 studies (Paluch et al., The Lancet Public Health), the benefit leveled off around 6,000–8,000 steps for adults 60 and older and 8,000–10,000 for younger adults.
about.active: Calories burned by movement, on top of what your body burns at rest. It isn't added to the weight estimate, which already counts your logged workouts, so nothing is counted twice.
about.weight: Weigh at the same time of day, ideally in the morning before eating. Day-to-day swings of a few pounds from water and food are normal, so watch the weekly trend.
about.rhr: For most adults, a resting heart rate between 60 and 100 beats per minute is normal (American Heart Association). Well-trained athletes often sit lower. Measure after sitting quietly for a few minutes.
about.bp: The American Heart Association lists normal as below 120/80 mmHg, elevated as 120–129 over below 80, and high blood pressure as 130/80 or higher. Sit quietly for 5 minutes, feet flat, arm at heart level, and take two readings.
about.spo2: Healthy blood oxygen is usually 95–100%. Home pulse oximeters and watches can read wrong with cold hands, movement or nail polish, and the FDA has warned they can be less accurate on darker skin. Talk to a doctor if you're regularly below 95% or short of breath.
about.sleep: The CDC recommends at least 7 hours of sleep a night for adults 18 to 60. Imported Apple Health sleep counts time asleep, not time in bed.
